groupings.title: Setup
groupings.description: Project initialization and manual compliance. /asome-setup writes .asome/config.json and bootstraps OpenSpec, AGENTS.md, the MCP allowlist, secret scanning and the docs/ registers. /asome-setup doctor audits the repo and your machine against the ASOME Engineering Manual without changing anything.

groupings.title: Product Discovery
groupings.description: Product discovery for ASOME projects: the docs/product/ doc set, user stories, and the decision and assumption registers. Runs upstream of SDD — it defines what to build and why, never how.

groupings.title: SDD Workflow
groupings.description: Spec-Driven Development for ASOME projects. Mandatory for Feature, Improvement, and Setup issues. Defines when SDD is required, maps SDD phases to board stages, and provides the full command sequence.

groupings.title: Dev Workflow
groupings.description: Skills for the ASOME day-to-day development cycle: issues, commits, branches, PRs, code review, and environment promotion.

groupings.title: Infrastructure
groupings.description: Skills for ASOME infrastructure: bootstrapping from canonical patterns, the team's AWS access profiles, auditing against best practices, analyzing AWS costs, and safely applying Terraform changes.

groupings.title: Sprint & Board
groupings.description: Skills for managing the ASOME sprint board, resequencing it against dependencies and contract milestones, tracking velocity, and generating daily standups.

groupings.title: Design System
groupings.description: Skills for generating design system documentation and component specs for ASOME Lab projects.

groupings.title: Calendar & Meetings
groupings.description: Skills for ASOME client-facing meetings: scheduling on the workspace calendar with ASOME's title, reminder and Google Meet conventions, running the project kick-off, and preparing every sprint demo — deck, acta and calendar events.
